title: A budgeted agent stops before another call when known spend equals its limit
steps: S1: run a scripted agent with a $1 budget and a first tool answer costing exactly $1.
S2: offer a second scripted answer and inspect the saved turn count and model request count.
expect: S1: the first answered turn is kept with its $1 cost.
S2: the agent returns AGENT_BUDGET before dispatching the second request.
evidence: The strict greater-than comparison treated a budget already consumed exactly as having room for another call.
fence: Known spend at or above the budget never starts another model call.

tests: a conversation exactly at its budget dispatches no additional model call
